scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning an R&B stadium outfit, [X] compares cargo or parachute pants, biker shorts, relaxed jeans, and a matching set around a concealed phone belt, hard seating, stairs, dancing, and loaded pockets; the waist position must preserve the intended streetwear silhouette without making the security layer conspicuous or uncomfortable.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在规划一套适合 R&B 体育场演唱会的穿搭时，[X]需要在工装裤或降落伞裤、骑行短裤、宽松牛仔裤和成套运动装之间选择。裤腰位置既要配合隐藏手机的贴身腰包，又要应对硬座、楼梯、舞动和口袋负重，同时不能破坏想要的街头轮廓。
examples: preferring High Rise when the phone belt needs more overlap and back coverage
using Mid Rise or Regular Rise when seated pressure and a relaxed streetwear proportion need balance
considering Low Rise only when the concealed layer remains hidden and loaded pockets will not destabilize the waist

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During recovery from tailbone pain, [X] needs loose sweatpants or soft shorts that work with a coccyx cushion and frequent sit-to-stand breaks, so the waistband must sit away from the irritated rear area without folding, pressing, or requiring a belt.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从尾骨疼痛中恢复时，[X]需要挑选能配合尾骨坐垫和频繁起身休息的宽松运动裤或柔软短裤；裤腰应避开受刺激的后侧区域，不能卷折、施压，也不应依赖腰带。
examples: choosing High Rise when its edge stays well above the painful contact zone
using Mid Rise or Regular Rise when it remains flat as the pelvis shifts between sitting and standing
rejecting a lower position when its waistband or rear seam lands on the sore area

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five women from a golf group, [X] compares white shorts, skorts, skirts, and jeans under preppy, retro, rock, or lounge dress themes; the waist position must support the theme's proportions and any tucked top while remaining plausible for grass and a seated meal.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位成年女性组织户外高尔夫午宴并确定着装主题时，[X]需要在白色短裤、裙裤、半身裙和牛仔裤之间考虑裤腰位置，使其既能呈现学院、复古、摇滚或休闲主题的比例并配合上衣塞腰，又适合草地活动和久坐用餐。
examples: using High Rise when a tucked blouse and retro theme need a clearly defined waist
choosing Mid Rise when classic club proportions and seated comfort carry equal weight
using Regular Rise or Low Rise when the chosen untucked top and relaxed theme do not need a raised waistline

scenarios.scenario_abstract: As a child who cannot yet speak moves from bare-bottom potty practice to underwear and loose pull-on bottoms, [X] chooses a waistband position the child can quickly locate, pull below the hips, and restore independently while still maintaining ordinary coverage between bathroom attempts.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 当一个尚不会说话的孩子从不穿下装的如厕训练过渡到内裤和宽松套穿下装时，[X]需要选择孩子能迅速摸到、拉过臀部并独立复位的裤腰位置，同时保证两次如厕之间的正常包覆。
examples: using Regular Rise when the waistband is easy to find and returns to a familiar position
choosing Mid Rise when coverage remains secure without slowing independent lowering
avoiding an overly high or low position when the child cannot clear it in time or pull it fully back into place

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing for a managerial interview, [X] chooses among men's suit trousers, dress pants, or chinos with a tucked shirt, belt, and jacket; the waist position should keep the outfit composed while seated and standing and project a conventional managerial proportion rather than looking casual or overly trend-driven.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在准备管理岗位面试时，[X]需要在男士西装裤、正装长裤或斜纹裤中选择，并搭配塞入裤腰的衬衫、腰带和外套。裤腰位置既要在坐下和站立时保持整洁，也要呈现传统稳重的管理者形象，而不是显得随意或过分追逐潮流。
examples: using Regular Rise as a conventional baseline with a suit and matching belt
choosing Mid Rise when a tucked shirt needs stability without an emphatically high waist
using High Rise only when it remains discreet under the jacket and rejecting Low Rise when the shirt will not stay composed

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After sharing photographs of two recently worn outfits, [X] reviews the visible waistline with straight-leg bottoms, cropped tops, fitted layers, and a recurring heel choice to decide whether a different rise would better balance torso and leg lines.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 分享两套近期穿过的造型照片后，[X]会结合直筒下装、短款上衣、修身叠穿和常穿的高跟鞋，复盘照片中可见腰线对上下身比例的影响，再判断另一种腰高是否更能平衡躯干与腿部线条。
examples: choosing High Rise when the photographed crop-top combination needs a visibly longer leg line
using Mid Rise when the same layers need a softer torso-to-leg division
keeping Regular Rise or considering Low Rise when the photographed outfit already looks balanced without raising the waist

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon college reunion with no dress code, [X] proposes familiar dark jeans with a sweater and classic clogs, then checks whether the jeans' waist placement works with the sweater hem and remains appropriately covered for campus walking and long conversations while seated.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加没有着装要求的下午校园同学聚会时，[X]打算穿熟悉的深色牛仔裤、毛衣和经典洞洞鞋。在定下造型前，还需要判断牛仔裤腰线是否能配合毛衣下摆，并在校园步行和久坐聊天时保持自然包覆。
examples: keeping Regular Rise when the familiar jeans preserve the easy, neutral outfit he proposed
using Mid Rise when seated back coverage matters without making the sweater bunch
considering High Rise or Low Rise only when the sweater length and relaxed silhouette remain coherent

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a personal half-elf cosplay in a strict toe-to-head layering order, [X] places leggings, hose, a skirt, garters, belts, and later armor so the lower garment's waist sits at a usable boundary between undergarments and the base layer without colliding with the character's belt or layered torso pieces.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按严格的从脚到头顺序规划个人半精灵 cosplay 时，[X]需要依次安排打底裤、长袜、半身裙、吊袜带、腰带和后续护甲。下装腰线应成为内衣层与基础层之间清晰可用的边界，并避免与角色腰带或躯干叠层冲突。
examples: using High Rise when the base layer needs continuous coverage beneath a corset or short upper layer
choosing Mid Rise or Regular Rise when several belts and layer boundaries need separation
using Low Rise when it keeps the lower base hidden beneath a planned hip belt without disrupting the toe-to-head dressing order

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a long-distance relocation made mostly by public transport, [X] fits only two bottoms into two small bags and wears the bulkiest clothes in transit; the travel-day waist position must remain comfortable and secure through prolonged sitting, luggage lifting, a crossbody document pouch, and repeated transfers without relying on a belt.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 依靠公共交通进行长途搬家时，[X]只能在两个小包中携带两件下装，并会在途中穿上最厚重的衣物。旅行日下装的裤腰位置需要在长时间久坐、搬抬行李、贴身背证件包和多次换乘时保持舒适稳固，而且不应依赖腰带。
examples: using High Rise when lifting and transfers require dependable back coverage
choosing Mid Rise or Regular Rise when prolonged sitting and a crossbody strap call for neutral pressure
keeping Low Rise only when it remains stable without a belt and does not create a gap while handling bags

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for breathable, comfortable shorts and chic tops for a summer holiday in Italy, [X] compares waist positions that coordinate with loose or tucked natural-fiber tops, stay comfortable in the heat, and support a more polished dinner look without requiring a separate lower garment for every occasion.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为意大利夏季假期购买透气舒适的短裤和利落上衣时，[X]需要比较能与宽松或塞腰的天然纤维上衣协调、在炎热天气中舒适、又能应付稍正式晚餐的裤腰位置，从而避免为每种场合分别携带一件下装。
examples: using High Rise when a tucked blouse or tailored-short look needs clear waist definition
choosing Mid Rise when walking comfort and a polished proportion need a middle ground
using Regular Rise or Low Rise with an untucked relaxed top when heat and abdominal freedom dominate
